# A partial, not a page

An `_`-prefixed file is excluded from @rspress/core's route table, so this is
never handed to the scan directly — only reached through the page that
imports it. Its demo's external import has to be collected anyway, or it
can't resolve at runtime.

```jsx live
import { DateTime } from "luxon";

export default function PartialDemo() {
  return <div>{DateTime.now().toISO()}</div>;
}
```
